ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast ratio characterized by approximately 85% low-intensity (black) pixel dominance with 15% high-intensity (white/grey) mottled highlights and localized circular high-intensity spots.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary black contiguous surface with diffuse grey-scale mottling concentrated near the median notch. Localized, high-contrast yellowish-white circular clusters are distributed across the distal regions of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression; vertex is partially occluded by water surface, but visible lobe convergence suggests an acute angle approximately between 40-50 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with varying pixel amplitudes (2-12 pixels) along the entire continuous trailing edge; peaks are notably sharp and more dense on the right lobe outer margin.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave-to-convex curvature transitioning from the median notch to the lateral tips; right lobe exhibits a more pronounced upward sweep relative to the left lobe in the current frame.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular, high-contrast pixel clusters (approximately 10-15 distinct marks) distributed on the ventral surface, consistent with barnacle attachment sites; prominent cluster observed on the upper-left lobe quadrant.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct white, unaligned linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) visible; one prominent horizontal scratch on the mid-right lobe and several diagonal marks on the left lobe surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive peripheral accumulation of live sessile organisms (barnacles) on the lateral tips, significantly altering the natural geometric boundary of the fluke tips.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly dense cluster of yellowish barnacles localized specifically at the extreme lateral tip of the right lobe, creating a distinct physical protrusion from the fluke edge.
